direct_official_checks: ground truth points are independently surveyed
ground truth is captured using GPS
individual ground truth point accuracy is plus or minus 3cm RMSE
timestamped LIDAR is compared against ground truth
LIDAR surveys must report less than plus or minus 15cm RMSE to pass QC
standard deviation and random error must be 10cm to pass QC
ground-truth QC thresholds are survey validation metrics not parcel-specific final uncertainty
quality_effect: Uses independent EA QC as validation evidence without misrepresenting it as the final parcel height error bar.
